summary: Project requires a new admin authentication system replacing the prior shared-passcode/admin-permission gate: Admin Dashboard access must be controlled exclusively via a separate three-step sequence of 25-character verification codes (stored server-side as hashes, never exposed client-side), with account-specific failed-attempt tracking and irreversible per-account admin lockout after 3 failures. Admins can rotate the three codes only after entering a separate 100-character master override code (also hashed server-side), with secure logging/audit of attempts and changes. Additionally, standard user login (e.g., email/Google/etc.) must be separated and must never grant Admin Dashboard access under any circumstances. After 3 failed admin verification attempts, the user must see a closable popup image and the Admin tab/link must be removed permanently for that locked-out user.
architectural_notes: Shop supports both Stripe checkout and an alternative request-quote/contact flow on selected products.
Customer login/accounts are needed to track loyalty points and to uniquely identify giveaway entrants by username.
Giveaway winner selection is performed via an admin-controlled random wheel populated from logged-in users.
Fulfillment/shipping options are configurable in admin; current operating mode is local coordination (no shipping) centered on Ashland/Westwood, KY.
Testimonials should support a user-submitted review flow (1–5 stars) in addition to admin management; star styling must match the mossy-green glow theme.
Portfolio management must support both photo and video uploads and a curated “What I have created for the community” subsection.

Admin entry point (button/link) should be publicly visible and clickable in the site navigation (desktop header + mobile hamburger menu); actual access must still be enforced by the shared-passcode gate + admin permission checks and server-side route protection.
Admin Dashboard access is controlled exclusively by a three-step sequence of 25-character verification codes; standard user login must never grant admin access.
All admin verification codes (3x 25-char) and the 100-character master override code must be stored server-side as hashes only; no plaintext exposure in client code.
Track per-user failed attempts and permanently lock out admin access for that specific account after 3 failures (irreversible, persists across code rotations).
known_issues: User requested unlimited-size photo/video portfolio uploads (“no matter the size/length”); this conflicts with practical storage limits and will require defined max file size/duration or alternative hosting/streaming strategy.
Admin button/link is currently not visible to the user; navigation needs to show Admin entry point on both mobile (hamburger) and desktop (top header) while keeping code gate protection.
"Permanently locked out" and "strict, irreversible, account-specific" admin removal creates a high-risk support scenario; requires explicit owner recovery policy (or confirm no recovery exists).

Moving away from Internet Identity/admin-permission gating toward code-only admin verification and introducing email/Google logins is a major auth-architecture shift; requires careful migration plan to avoid breaking existing accounts/admin tooling.

User provided plaintext admin verification codes in the prompt; ensure implementation does not embed/expose these codes in frontend bundles, logs, or client config (must be server-side hashed/validated only).

User provided plaintext 100-character Master Override Code in the prompt; ensure implementation stores/validates it only as a server-side hash and never exposes/logs it client-side or in backend logs.

User reports a "Connection closed" / service connection could not be established error triggered when clicking the website login button; may be browser-specific and requires cross-browser investigation/testing.

User continues to paste plaintext admin verification codes and the master override code into chat; ensure support/UX discourages this and that no plaintext is ever logged or stored client-side/server-side beyond hashed verification.

User provided a new set of plaintext admin verification codes and a plaintext master override code in chat; ensure these are never embedded in frontend bundles or logged, and are only stored/validated as server-side hashes.

existing_features.title: Create a responsive multi-page marketing website for “The Creator of Side Quests” with the following routes/pages and user-facing copy (in English) based on the provided prompt: Home (hero with headline/subheadline/CTAs/quotes), About (bio + vision/mission/emission + quotes), Services (categories + micro-services + “starting at” placeholders + KY guidance + quotes), Shop, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact (form with specified fields + response-time guidance + quotes), Hours & Policies (hours, payments/quotes, scope/licensing, returns/adjustments, local service area, anti-discrimination + quote). Include CTAs throughout linking to Contact/booking and Shop/Services as specified.

Apply a consistent premium medieval-fantasy visual theme across the entire frontend using deep mossy greens and dark tones, elegant serif + sans-serif typography pairing, subtle textured backgrounds, and tasteful motion (hover effects, smooth transitions, subtle animations) while keeping content energetic, readable, human-centered, and approachable (neurodivergent-chaotic but professional tone). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

Implement SEO-friendly structure for the React app: per-route document titles and meta descriptions derived from the page content, semantic headings (one H1 per page), accessible link/button labeling, and a crawlable internal navigation structure.

Add clickable social media integration as icon links (and/or a dedicated section) that can be configured with the creator’s profile URLs, enabling users to click out to message or view content on platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube).

Implement Internet Identity authentication for users (customers) and a protected Admin area. Restrict Admin access to a single admin account (the creator) using an allowlisted Internet Identity principal stored in backend settings.

Create an Admin panel that allows the admin to manage: Portfolio items (including photo upload), Testimonials (create/edit/delete), Shop products (create/edit/delete), pricing, in-stock/out-of-stock toggles, fulfillment options (pickup/dropoff/delivery toggles), and policies (including default “no shipping” stance but configurable).

Build a Shop experience with (a) product browsing and detail views, (b) Stripe checkout for eligible products supporting debit/credit/digital cards, and (c) a per-product “Request quote / Contact to purchase” option that routes users to Contact and/or social links instead of checkout when enabled.

Implement a Contact/Quote request system that persists submissions (from the Contact page and from quote-only product flows) for admin review, including the specified fields (Name, Email, Project Type, Timeline, Budget, Project Description) and optional linkage to a product.

Implement coupon creation and redemption: admin can create digital coupons (code, discount type/value, validity window, usage limits), and users can apply a coupon at checkout (Stripe-enabled products) and/or have coupons awarded as loyalty rewards.

Implement a loyalty points system: users earn points from purchases and other actions (signing up, visiting, sharing), points are tracked per user, and points can be converted into rewards such as coupons/discounts/free gifts/free items after thresholds configured by admin.

Implement a giveaway system oriented around livestreams: any signed-in user can be added as an entrant (by username/identity display), entrants appear on an admin “random wheel”, and the admin can trigger a random spin to select a winner; the system records winners and timestamps.

Implement public Portfolio and Testimonials pages that display the admin-managed content with media (portfolio images), including interactive UI elements (e.g., filters, cards, modal/lightbox viewing for portfolio items) consistent with the site theme.

Support media uploads for admin-managed entities (portfolio images, product images) by storing image blobs in the backend and serving them to the frontend via stable URLs/asset endpoints, with basic limits and graceful error handling.

Add explicit location/service constraints messaging across Shop and relevant pages: highlight Ashland/Westwood area of Kentucky, coordination for drop-off/pickup for physical/custom/in-person jobs, and “no shipping” by default; ensure fulfillment settings and product messaging reflect these constraints.

Add a frontend static asset pipeline for generated brand imagery (logo/hero/background textures/icons) stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and used across the site (header/favicon/hero sections) without routing images through the backend.

Replace the placeholder Admin Products page with a full product management UI that lets the admin list, create, edit, and delete products, including image upload, price, description, category, in-stock toggle, and requires-quote toggle, using the existing backend product APIs and existing admin route protection.

Implement a user-facing testimonial creation flow on the public Testimonials page that allows a signed-in user to click a “Create Testimony” button and submit a 1–5 star review using mossy-green glowing stars (not gold), and ensure testimonials display uses the same mossy-green star styling.

Replace the placeholder Admin Testimonials page with an admin testimonials management UI that lets the admin view, create, edit, and delete testimonials (including rating), using existing backend testimonial APIs and maintaining consistent mossy-green glowing star styling for rating controls.

Replace the placeholder Admin Giveaways page with a giveaway wheel UI for admins that allows selecting an active giveaway, viewing entrants, adding entrants as admin, triggering a random wheel spin animation, selecting a winner, and displaying winner history using the existing backend giveaway APIs.

Replace the placeholder Admin Portfolio page with a portfolio uploader/manager UI for admins that supports uploading portfolio media, setting title/description/category, listing existing portfolio items, and editing/deleting items using the existing backend portfolio and blob-storage APIs; include a category workflow that supports a dedicated “What I have created for the community” grouping.
Add a shared-code gate to all Admin routes so that a signed-in user must enter the shared code "A7F9K2M8Q4R6T1Z5X3LJH9C8" to access any /admin page, even if the user already has admin permissions.
Create an Admin "Access" management page within the admin panel that allows a verified admin (admin permission + shared-code session) to grant and revoke admin access for other accounts.
Update the existing Admin route protection flow to incorporate the shared-code step while preserving the current Internet Identity login requirement and existing admin-permission checks.

Update the site header navigation so an “Admin” link is always visible and clickable for everyone (regardless of login/admin status): on desktop it must appear in the top header navigation (very top of the website), and on mobile it must appear inside the top-right hamburger menu.

Preserve the existing admin protection behavior on /admin routes (Internet Identity login requirement, admin permission check, and shared-code gate). If a non-authorized user clicks the always-visible “Admin” link, the user must still be prevented from accessing admin content by the existing guard screens.

Ensure that standard website login only authenticates a user for normal (non-admin) site features and can never grant Admin Dashboard access by itself. Admin Dashboard access must be controlled exclusively by a separate three-step verification system (not by simply being logged in).

Decouple current Admin Dashboard route protection from any login-derived admin permission (e.g., roles/allowlists) so that AdminRouteGuard does not treat being logged-in or being marked as an admin role as sufficient for access; it must require the dedicated admin verification state produced by the separate three-step verification system.

Add clear user-facing messaging on admin guard screens stating that logging in is not sufficient for admin access and that admin access requires completing the separate three-step verification process.

Replace the current single shared-code admin gate with a three-step sequential admin verification flow that requires users to enter three codes in the exact order (Code #1 then Code #2 then Code #3) before any /admin content becomes accessible.

Implement a new Admin verification screen/component to replace the existing single-code UI (frontend/src/components/auth/AdminSharedCodeGateScreen.tsx) with a step-by-step interface that clearly indicates Step 1/3, Step 2/3, Step 3/3 and only allows progressing after each successful entry.

Update frontend admin route protection (frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteGuard.tsx) and the related hooks/utilities (frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminSharedCodeGate.ts and frontend/src/utils/adminSharedCodeSession.ts) to track multi-step verification state and to consider the user authorized only when all three steps are completed.
Ensure the three provided codes are treated as secrets: do not embed the plaintext codes anywhere in the frontend bundle, and do not log them to the browser console, backend logs, or error messages.

Make the new three-step verification flow the only supported path to Admin Dashboard access and remove/disable any remaining UI/logic implying the old single-code gate (e.g., “Enter the first verification code to begin” in the current gate screen should be updated to the new step-based wording).

Update the admin verification UI flow so that when the backend indicates the caller has reached 3 total failed attempts (lockout), the app immediately displays a closable popup modal showing the provided lockout image, and the verification screen stops accepting further code submissions for that caller.

Conditionally remove/hide the “Admin” navigation link in the site header (desktop nav and mobile hamburger menu) for any caller who is permanently locked out of admin access, based on backend lockout status; the Admin link must continue to appear for non-locked-out users.

Ensure admin route protection screens handle locked-out callers: attempting to visit any /admin route while locked out must not reveal admin content and must show the same lockout popup image (closable) plus an English explanation that the account’s admin access is permanently disabled.
Add the uploaded lockout image as a static frontend asset under frontend/public/assets/generated and use it for the lockout popup UI (do not serve it from the backend).

Update the frontend so that once a principal is permanently locked out, the Admin navigation entry disappears immediately for that account, and any attempt to access /admin routes shows the lockout UI while leaving all non-admin site features fully usable.

Create a new protected Admin page titled “Verification Code Management” inside the Admin Dashboard that allows administrators to rotate Codes #1–#3, but only after successfully verifying the Master Override Code.
Implement frontend API hooks/mutations to call the backend for (a) verifying the Master Override Code and (b) saving new Codes #1–#3, with clear success/error feedback and without logging secrets.
Update the Admin Dashboard navigation to include a link to the new “Verification Code Management” panel.

Ensure the frontend always checks the backend’s permanent lockout status before rendering any Admin interface, and continues to prevent access (and hides the Admin navigation entry) for permanently locked-out accounts.

Fix the reported “Connection closed / service connection could not be established” issue triggered by clicking the website Login button by making the Internet Identity login flow resilient across major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera/Opera GX) and by providing clear user-facing error handling when the auth popup cannot be opened or the auth session fails.

Harden actor initialization so that cross-browser differences or URL-parameter/session behaviors cannot break authenticated or anonymous app usage (including login/logout), and ensure failures in access-control initialization do not crash the app.

Ensure the full website UI is fully responsive and functional across a comprehensive set of screen sizes (small Android phones, iPhones, iPads/tablets, and desktop sizes), including header navigation, mobile hamburger menu behavior, forms, dialogs/modals, and key flows (Shop, Contact, Testimonials, Admin entry guard screens).

Add a lightweight cross-browser QA checklist and automated smoke coverage (where feasible within the existing React app tooling) focused on the login button/auth flow and critical navigation, to prevent regressions of the reported connection/login issue.

Add a Master Override entry option directly on the three-step Admin verification screen (frontend/src/components/auth/AdminSharedCodeGateScreen.tsx) so a logged-in user can choose to enter the Master Override Code (instead of Code #1) to immediately obtain an admin session and proceed into the Admin Dashboard in order to access the existing “Verification Code Management” page and rotate Codes #1–#3.

Implement a new backend API for verifying the Master Override Code at the verification gate, and wire it to the frontend via a new React Query mutation hook (extend frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminSharedCodeGate.ts) so the Master Override Code can be used as an alternative entry path at Step 1/3.

Ensure AdminRouteGuard and the gate screen continue to behave correctly when access is granted via Master Override: successful Master Override verification must satisfy the guard’s requirements for rendering admin routes without requiring the user to manually complete Code Steps 1–3.

Ensure the new Code #1/#2/#3 and the new Master Override Code are treated as secrets: do not embed their plaintext values anywhere in the frontend bundle, and do not log them to browser console, backend logs, or error messages; store/validate them server-side in a way suitable for rotation (e.g., hashed/derived representation rather than plaintext).

Keep the Admin Dashboard closed off: all /admin routes and all admin-only backend mutations must remain protected by the admin verification session (three-step verification), and must not become publicly accessible.

Update the frontend Admin verification UX copy (gate screen and verification-code management page) as needed so it accurately reflects the system behavior: three steps in order (Step 1/3, 2/3, 3/3) and Master Override Code for code rotation, without referencing any retired/previous admin authentication system.

new_feature_requests.summary: Multi-page website (Home, About, Services, Shop, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact, Hours & Policies) with provided copy, CTAs, quotes, and side-quest messaging

Medieval-fantasy premium UI theme (deep mossy greens/dark tones, textured backgrounds, serif/sans typography) with subtle animations, flippable cards, hover effects, smooth transitions, immersive layouts
Fully responsive (desktop/tablet/mobile) and SEO-friendly layout/copy
Clickable social media integration (icons/links to user-provided profiles for messaging/content)
Shop with product listings and Stripe checkout (debit/credit/digital cards), plus per-product option for “request quote/contact to purchase” instead of checkout
Admin panel (single admin account) to manage portfolio items (photo uploads) and testimonials content
Admin panel inventory & product management: prices, photos, in-stock/out-of-stock toggles, fulfillment options (pickup/dropoff/delivery toggles), and configurable policies (no shipping currently)
Coupon system: admin-created digital coupons usable as rewards/discounts
User accounts/login for customers to support loyalty points tracking and giveaway entry identity (username-based)
Loyalty points system: earn points via purchases and other actions (signup/visiting/sharing) with conversion to rewards (coupons/discounts/free gifts/free items after thresholds)
Giveaway system: logged-in usernames added to a random wheel in admin panel; admin triggers wheel spin to randomly select winner; designed for livestream giveaways

Location/service constraints content + logic: Ashland/Westwood, Kentucky focus; coordinate drop-off/pickup for physical/custom/3D-print/Cricut and in-person jobs; no shipping by default but adjustable in admin

Build full Admin UI (“Admin tab”) that centralizes access to all admin features (Shop management, Portfolio management, Testimonials management, Coupons, Giveaways) restricted to the single site-owner account
Product management admin UI: add/edit products with photos, custom prices/descriptions, in-stock/out-of-stock toggle, and fulfillment options (pickup/drop-off/delivery)
Portfolio uploader/admin UI: upload/manage portfolio photos and videos; include a dedicated section “What I have created for the community” for Cricut/3D-print community items
Testimonials user-facing creation flow: users can click “Create Testimony” and submit a 1–5 star review using mossy-green glowing stars (not gold)
Giveaway wheel admin UI: manage entrants and run the random wheel/spin to select winners for livestream giveaways
Newsletter system: admin can create and send newsletters via the website, including one-off birthday coupon/gift-card newsletters targeted to specific accounts
User profile field for birthday and automated birthday experience: site recognizes birthdays and delivers a custom birthday message/card + an admin-configurable coupon (e.g., 50% off next purchase)

Make the Admin button/link always visible and clickable for everyone: on mobile it appears in the top-right hamburger menu; on desktop it appears at the very top header/nav. Access remains protected by the existing shared-passcode gate.

Replace existing admin access gating with a separate three-step admin verification system (three 25-char codes, hashed server-side, sequential entry) plus per-account failed-attempt tracking and irreversible admin lockout after 3 failures; include master override code (100 chars) required to change/rotate codes with secure logging

Separate base user login (email/Google/etc.) from admin access: normal logins grant only standard user access and can never grant Admin Dashboard access; admin access is controlled only by the three-step verification system

Update backend authorization so that admin-only operations are gated by the separate three-step verification system rather than being implied by the caller’s login state. Ensure there is no backend API that grants admin capability purely from standard login/authentication.

Update the backend admin verification APIs and authorization checks so that admin access is granted only after successful completion of all three steps, and remove/retire the old single-code (ADMIN_SHARED_CODE) verification/session behavior from backend/main.mo.
After 3 failed admin verification attempts, show an immediate closable popup image indicating lockout
After irreversible admin lockout (3 failures), permanently hide/remove the Admin tab/link from site navigation for that specific locked-out account

Implement per-principal tracking of failed admin verification attempts across the entire 3-step admin verification flow, and permanently lock out admin verification for that principal after 3 total failures (across any steps). On lockout, the backend must (a) mark the principal as locked out persistently, (b) invalidate/clear any in-progress admin verification session for that principal, and (c) ensure subsequent verification attempts cannot progress even if the correct codes are later provided.

Expose a backend API to allow the frontend to determine whether the current caller is permanently locked out of admin access (and optionally the current failed-attempt count / remaining attempts), so the UI can hide the Admin navigation entry and show lockout messaging appropriately.

Persist permanent admin lockout per Internet Identity principal so that after 3 total failed admin verification attempts (across any step), that principal is irreversibly locked out of all admin access, and the lockout remains enforced across canister upgrades and regardless of future admin code changes.

Ensure failed admin verification attempts are counted consistently across all three verification steps, and that reaching 3 total failures triggers permanent lockout immediately, clears any in-progress verification session state, and prevents further progression even if correct codes are later provided.
Add an in-Admin-Dashboard “Verification Code Management” panel that requires entering the 100-character Master Override Code before allowing admins to edit/save Codes #1–#3 (code rotation UI)
Add backend support for a Master Override Code that must be verified before allowing any rotation/edit of Admin verification Codes #1, #2, and #3.
Persist the admin verification codes (#1–#3) and Master Override Code as server-side secrets suitable for rotation (do not keep them as hard-coded plaintext constants in backend/main.mo).

Persist each caller’s Admin eligibility status (including permanent lockout after failed verification attempts) in stable backend state so it survives canister upgrades, code rotations, and any other platform updates.

Update backend admin authorization and verification logic so the permanent lockout check is authoritative and always enforced before allowing any admin verification step to progress and before allowing any admin-only backend operation (i.e., all functions that call admin verification must deny permanently locked principals).

Update backend query APIs used by the frontend (isPermanentlyLocked and getAdminVerificationStatus) so they reflect the persistent/stable lockout status, not only the current in-memory verification session state.

Ensure full cross-browser compatibility (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera/Opera GX, etc.) and full responsiveness across all screen sizes/devices (Android/iPhone/iPad/tablets/desktop) with QA/testing to confirm everything (including login) functions correctly

Add a Master Override entry option directly on the three-step Admin verification screen (pre-dashboard) as an explicit Step 1 / bypass path, allowing an authorized admin to enter the Master Override Code to reach code-rotation/reset flow when they cannot complete Steps 1–3.

Update the backend’s active Admin verification credentials so that Admin Dashboard access requires successful completion of the three-step sequence using the newly provided Code #1, Code #2, and Code #3 (in that exact order), and ensure the new Master Override Code is the only master override credential accepted for master-override verification and code rotation.

Add upgrade-safe initialization/migration so that existing deployments are updated to use the newly provided Code #1/#2/#3 and Master Override Code values (without requiring the old codes to be known), while preserving existing per-principal permanent lockout state.
